study.name: Arthur's Study
study.description: A spacious, wood-paneled room. The air is heavy with the smell of old paper and red wine. Arthur's body was found slumped on the desk here.

desk.name: Arthur's Desk
desk.description: A massive mahogany desk cluttered with business ledgers, letters, and a half-empty glass of red wine.

glass.name: Stained Glass
glass.description: A crystal wine glass containing dregs of dark red liquid. An odor of almonds lingers.

drawer.name: Mahogany Drawer
drawer.description: A heavy wooden drawer. Inside is a folder labeled 'New Will - Draft'.

phone.name: Arthur's Smartphone
phone.description: Arthur's personal phone. It is unlocked.

fireplace.name: Stone Fireplace
fireplace.description: Cold ashes and half-burned logs sit inside the grate.

ashes.name: Burnt Papers
ashes.description: Among the ashes is a piece of paper that escaped complete destruction.

cabinet.name: Display Cabinet
cabinet.description: Glass cabinets containing trophies, old photos, and medical supplies.

floor.name: Study Floor
floor.description: A soft Persian rug covers the floor. Near the chair, something glints.

pocketwatch.name: Metallic Object
pocketwatch.description: A silver watch lying in the shadow of the desk leg.

kitchen.name: Mansion Kitchen
kitchen.description: A large commercial-grade kitchen. Copper pots hang from the ceiling. James and Olivia spend their time here.

counter.name: Kitchen Counter
counter.description: A clean counter with a silver tea set and a teapot, still slightly warm.

pantry.name: Pantry Shelves
pantry.description: Shelves lined with jars of flour, sugar, spices, and cleaning agents.

deskkey.name: Jammed Drawer
deskkey.description: A drawer at the bottom of the pantry shelf. Opening it reveals a small brass key.

hiddenshelf.name: Pantry Undershelf
hiddenshelf.description: Checking underneath the spices shelf... something is taped here.

gardens.name: Mansion Gardens
gardens.description: The gardens surrounding the estate. Rain is falling heavily, washing away footprints quickly.

flowerbed.name: Flowerbed near Study Window
flowerbed.description: A bed of wet soil right outside Arthur's study window.

footprint.name: Indented Soil
footprint.description: Deep prints left in the mud.

security_room.name: Security Office
security_room.description: A small office filled with monitors displaying feeds of the grounds. The console lights blink.

computer.name: Security Computer
computer.description: The main logging console. It is locked by a password.

gate_logs.name: Gate Entry/Exit Logs
gate_logs.description: Digital timestamps of vehicles entering and exiting the estate gates.

hall_logs.name: Hallway Motion Sensor Logs
hall_logs.description: Detailed log files showing motion events in the study corridor.

whiteboard.name: Security Noticeboard
whiteboard.description: A small white board with scribbled notes. One note lists a phone extension. Another note is partially erased but shows: 'PC Code: 1003'

studio.name: Sophia's Studio
studio.description: An airy loft filled with canvases, tubes of oil paint, and the scent of turpentine.

easel.name: Work Easel
easel.description: A large canvas showing a dark watercolor landscape. Next to it are sales records.
